data.why: The repo bundles data/sample_records.csv as a fallback dataset and a 'Use fallback sample data only' checkbox in the sidebar, so no additional data needs to be written or uploaded; live mode also works against the public V&A API.

goals: Search V&A object records (e.g. by place name like 'Etruria') to find candidate objects for archival follow-up
Inspect catalogue fields (maker, maker role, place, date, material, technique) for each record
Use the computed archival tractability score and evidence reasons to identify which records are worth deeper archival research
Filter records by date range to focus on a historical period of interest
Review recommended archival next steps per record and export the enriched table as CSV for offline use

review.summary: The goal and phases match the README's stated purpose: first-stage archival triage of V&A records using a transparent tractability score, evidence reasons and suggested next steps. Coverage, depth and the 8 sampled screens are all sound. It needs small fixes before filing: it doesn't mention the crash when the filters leave zero records, two actions are mislabelled or miscited, and the data note gives record counts without their filter settings.
